shows: iPhone showing a popover-style action sheet near the top with short title, message, and three full-width pill actions, the first red Destructive.
visual_question: How are an iOS 27 action sheet's title, message, and destructive action arranged?
facts: Glass card anchored at top, not bottom; title bold, message regular; 3 stacked rounded-pill buttons; Destructive red text first; no Cancel button; Light only; content behind dimmed.

shows: Share sheet with header (thumbnail, title, subtitle, Collaborate pill, permission line), close X, people row, app row, circular action row, grouped action list.
visual_question: What zones make up the iOS 27 share sheet?
facts: Header with icon, title, subtitle, Collaborate pill with chevron, permission caption; circular X dismiss top right; rows in order: people (badged avatars, 2-line names), apps, circular quick actions, grouped text actions with leading glyphs and inset dividers; grabber on top; sheet extends past bottom edge and scrolls.

shows: Two iPhones with alerts: left a text-field alert with Cancel and Default side by side, right the same with stacked Default, Destructive, Cancel.
visual_question: How do iOS 27 alerts lay out 2 versus 3 actions and a text-field variant?
facts: Rounded glass card centered over dimmed screen; bold short title plus short message; optional grouped input with Value label and placeholder; 2 actions side by side as pills (Cancel gray left, Default blue filled right); 3+ stacked full-width pills ordered Default blue, Destructive red text, Cancel gray; back and select toolbar buttons visible behind.

shows: Bottom sheet Colors picker with eyedropper, close X, Grid/Spectrum/Sliders segmented control, swatch grid, opacity slider with percent field, current swatch and preset dots.
visual_question: What does the iOS 27 color picker sheet contain?
facts: Medium sheet over gray; eyedropper leading, centered Colors title, X trailing; segmented Grid/Spectrum/Sliders (Grid selected); 10x10 swatch grid with white outlined selected cell; OPACITY caps label, checkerboard-to-color slider with thumb and 100% field; large current swatch plus 2 rows of preset dots (selected ringed) and plus button.

shows: Context menu below a content card: top row of 3 icon-over-label buttons (first highlighted, third red), then Label, disabled, destructive rows, divider, Submenu row with chevron.
visual_question: How does an iOS 27 context menu order icon buttons, actions, disabled, destructive, and submenus?
facts: Rounded glass panel anchored under content; top inline row of 3 icon+label tiles (first pressed gray, third red truncated Destruc...); divider; rows with leading icon: normal, disabled gray, destructive red; divider; Submenu text row with trailing chevron and no icon.

shows: Control Center over blurred wallpaper with connectivity cluster, media player, toggles, vertical brightness and volume sliders, focus tile, page indicators at right.
visual_question: How are Control Center controls sized and arranged on iOS 27?
facts: Glass tiles on blurred wallpaper; plus top left, power top right; 2x2 connectivity cluster, wide media tile with Track/Artist and transport; circular toggles (camera, mute highlighted white, rotation lock, mirroring, battery); two tall vertical sliders with fill and glyph (brightness, volume); wide Title/Detail tiles with icon; large square tile; right edge vertical page dots (favorites, home, music, home, wireless); status row shows signal and battery percent. Blue fill for active Wi-Fi.

shows: Three iPhones with empty states: text only, icon plus title and description, large star with title; each with a bottom filled pill primary action.
visual_question: How do iOS 27 empty states pair copy, optional icon, and bottom primary action?
facts: Centered text block mid-screen; variant 1 gray 2-line text only; variant 2 tinted circle check icon plus bold title plus gray description; variant 3 star glyph, bold title, 3-line description; full-width filled pill primary action at bottom in tint color (blue, pink, yellow); large title and back plus ellipsis buttons above.

shows: Two iPhones: Face ID scanning glyph and success checkmark in a black rounded square at the top over blank white screen.
visual_question: What does the iOS 27 Face ID scan and success indicator look like?
facts: Black rounded square near Dynamic Island with green face glyph (scanning) then green circled check (success); soft shadow below; rest of screen blank white; Light only.

shows: Home icon long-press menu over blurred Home Screen: Remove App red, Require Face ID, Edit Home Screen, 4 placeholder Actions, widget size picker row at bottom.
visual_question: How is the Home Screen quick action menu structured for an app icon?
facts: Glass menu attached above blurred icon; items with leading glyph: Remove App red first, system items, then app Action rows; bottom row of 5 size-picker glyphs with first selected; background blurred, tapped icon unblurred beneath.

shows: Four iPhones showing widget placeholder sizes on the Home Screen: small, medium, large, extra large with name caption below.
visual_question: What widget footprints fit on the Home Screen grid?
facts: 4 sizes in a 4-column grid: small 2x2 icon cells, medium 4x2, large 4x4, extra large taller than large; rounded corners; Widget Name caption centered below like an icon label; dashed inset safe area; icons reflow around the widget; Search pill and dock persist.

shows: Plain iPhone Home Screen with 4-column icon grid, labels, a badge on My App, Search pill, and dock.
visual_question: Home Screen anatomy for app icons and badge.
facts: Icons rounded squares with labels below; red circular badge top right of My App with count 1; Search pill above dock; dock of 4 icons in glass tray; blurred wallpaper.
reason: Wallpaper and icon grid are covered better by K084 and K083; only badge placement is new.

shows: Strip of 11 iPhones showing keyboards: lowercase, uppercase, punctuation, numeric, Find, Find and Replace, Email, Web Search, URL, Number Pad, Emoji.
visual_question: Which keyboard type and accessory bar suits each input type?
facts: Image is very wide (5082 px) so details are small. Letters: suggestion bar above; 123 and emoji and dictation keys at bottom; Find shows previous/next arrows, field with 3 of 6, check; Replace adds Done and Replace field; Email shows Passwords autofill row and @ and period keys; Web Search blue arrow return key; URL shows .com, slash keys and clear/close field; Number Pad is 3x4 with letters under digits and delete; Emoji has search and Genmoji.

shows: Three iPhones with lists: inset grouped rows with accessories, plain list with swipe actions, indexed alphabetical section list.
visual_question: Which row accessory and list styles exist and how do they differ?
facts: Grouped inset rows: Title/Detail with star and chevron, subtitle variant, thumbnail row, blue Button text, blue chevron, date pills, time pill with reorder grip, pop-up with up-down chevrons, stepper, switch, centered blue Action; plain rows with swipe: row slides left revealing 3 circular colored actions with labels; indexed list with letter section headers and dividers.

shows: iPhone Lock Screen with date and city line, large clock, weather and fitness and sunrise widgets, flashlight and camera buttons, home indicator.
visual_question: Where do Lock Screen widgets and quick buttons sit?
facts: Date line above large translucent clock; 3 widgets in a row beneath: rectangular weather text, circular gauge, circular small; flashlight bottom left and camera bottom right as circular glass buttons; home indicator bar at bottom; status bar without time.

shows: Two iPhones: text selection edit menu as compact Cut/Copy/Paste bar with chevron, and expanded menu with icons and submenus.
visual_question: How does the edit menu on selected text compact and expand?
facts: Compact capsule of Cut, Copy, Paste with trailing chevron button below selection handles; expanded panel has top row icon-over-label Cut/Copy/Paste, divider, rows with icons (Paste and Match Style, Add Link), divider, Replace... and AutoFill with chevrons and Writing Tools; selection highlight light blue with blue handles; title and toolbar buttons above.

shows: Two Lock Screen iPhones: stacked notification banners and a long-look notification with custom content and actions below.
visual_question: How do notification banners stack and expand on the Lock Screen?
facts: Left: 4 glass banners with app icon, bold title, message, time right; stacked layers below last indicate more. Right: expanded white card with header icon, title, description, time, custom content area, and separate glass action list below with icon-leading rows.

shows: Two iPhones with date pickers: floating calendar popover with Time pill, and inline cards with month grid, time, and date pills.
visual_question: How do date and time picker controls look in the popover versus in a list?
facts: Month header with blue chevron and previous/next arrows; weekday row; today in blue tinted circle; selected day black filled circle; Time row with gray pill; right variant shows grouped rows with Title and June 2024 / 9:41 AM pills. Left weekday header reads SUN MON WED THU FRI SAT SUN, a design-kit inconsistency.

shows: Three iPhones with sheets: medium sheet over dimmed screen, full-height sheet with card stacked behind, and medium sheet over a light screen.
visual_question: How do medium and large sheets look with grabber, close, and confirm?
facts: Grabber at top; X close leading in gray circle, centered Title, blue filled check trailing; medium detent over dimmed content with inset side edges; large sheet reaches near the top with previous screen scaled behind on black; light and dim variants of background.

shows: Sliders screen with two grouped cards: stepped slider with turtle and rabbit glyphs at 3 positions, and plain slider at 3 positions.
visual_question: How do sliders look at min, mid, max with and without end glyphs and tick marks?
facts: Card 1: glyph slider with turtle left and rabbit right, tick dots under the track; Card 2: full-width track; filled blue left of thumb; white thumb pill; positions at min, mid, max; gray unfilled track.

shows: Steppers screen with single row labeled Stepper and a minus and plus capsule on the right.
visual_question: What does a stepper look like in a row?
facts: Label left, gray capsule with minus and plus separated by a divider at trailing side; inside a rounded white card on grouped gray background.

shows: Two iPhones: floating tab bar with 2 tabs plus detached square button, and 3 tabs.
visual_question: How does the iOS 27 floating tab bar show selection and a separated search or prominent tab?
facts: Floating glass capsule near bottom; selected tab has gray pill highlight and blue icon and label; unselected black; left variant adds separate circular button at trailing end (search role); right variant 3 equally spaced tabs; icon over label.

shows: Text fields in a grouped card: placeholder, focused empty with cursor, filled with clear button, and filled value.
visual_question: What are the placeholder, focused, filled, and clearable states of a text field?
facts: Rows in one inset card with hairline dividers; placeholder light gray; focused shows blue cursor; filled with gray circled x clear button at trailing edge while editing; filled idle black without clear.

shows: Switches screen with one on row (green) and one off row (gray) in a grouped card.
visual_question: What do the on and off switch states look like?
facts: Green track with white knob right (on); gray track with white knob left (off); trailing in row; no footer or dependents.

shows: Three iPhones with bottom toolbars: search field with close, icon buttons with a prominent one, and text buttons with prominent button.
visual_question: How are bottom toolbar items grouped and which one is prominent?
facts: Floating glass items, not a full-width bar; variant 1 search capsule with mic and separate circular X; variant 2 one leading circle button, trailing circle plus blue filled prominent; variant 3 text capsule Button leading, blue Prominent Button trailing.

shows: Five iPhones with top navigation bars: two-line title left, two-line centered, large title with grouped actions, compact large, and standard centered title with prominent action.
visual_question: Which title and action configurations exist in the top navigation bar?
facts: Back is a circular glass button; trailing actions as single circle or grouped capsule of 3; subtitle under title on left, centered, or large; large title below bar; compact large title in the bar row; blue filled prominent trailing circle in two variants.
